context: Two friends gossip about a couple they both know
purpose: Teach: 休暇/冗談/貴方/ウチ/仕掛け/カップル/やりとり/グルメ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、聞いた？ウチのバイト先のあの二人、ついに付き合い始めたらしいよ。
lines.en: Hey, did you hear? Those two from my workplace finally started dating.
lines.style: Casual gossipy tone with rising excitement, leaning in conspiratorially close.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: え、嘘でしょ！？冗談じゃなくて？私ずっとお似合いのカップルだと思ってたんだけど！
lines.en: What, no way!? You're not joking? I always thought they were such a perfect couple!
lines.style: Squeals with romantic delight, hands clasped, eyes sparkling dreamily.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あんたの勘って本当に当たるよね。実は彼の方が、夏の休暇中にずっと仕掛けを準備してたみたい。
lines.en: Your intuition really is spot on. Apparently he'd been preparing his moves all through summer break.
lines.style: Impressed, slightly teasing, with a knowing smirk and raised eyebrow.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: やだもう、ロマンチック！どんな仕掛けだったの？ちゃんと最初から全部教えてよ！
lines.en: Oh stop, that's so romantic! What kind of setup was it? Tell me everything from the start!
lines.style: Bouncing eagerly, voice rising with breathless curiosity and hunger for details.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 彼女が前から行きたがってたグルメ雑誌の店、二人きりで予約しちゃったんだって。
lines.en: He secretly booked just the two of them at that restaurant from the gourmet magazine she wanted to visit.
lines.style: Reporting like a satisfied insider with slow reveal and dramatic pauses.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うわぁ、完璧じゃない！それで、その後のやりとりはどうなってるの？毎日連絡してる感じ？
lines.en: Wow, that's just perfect! So how are their exchanges going now? Are they texting every day?
lines.style: Melting with vicarious joy, fishing greedily for more romantic details.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それがさ、もう冗談みたいにラブラブで、休憩中ずっと自分のスマホ見てニヤニヤしてるの。
lines.en: The thing is, they're so lovey-dovey it's almost a joke—he keeps grinning at his own phone the entire break.
lines.style: Eye-rolling fondly with an exaggerated sigh mixed with amused affection.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいなぁ、私もそんな恋したい！ねえ、貴方の次のシフト、私も様子見に行っていい？
lines.en: Lucky them, I want a romance like that too! Hey, can I come watch them on your next shift?
lines.style: Whining playfully then perking up with mischievous determination and a grin.
